findings.finding: Observation opportunity zeros are not identified
findings.evidence: StationDates: 74 min/max rows. StationLocations: no EndDate populated and no interruptions. Raw trails only DATA. Publication Par15 and Par28 acknowledge inactive and missed stations.
findings.impact: Silent time bins cannot be interpreted as observed zero detections.

findings.finding: Station metadata do not form mutually consistent complete active intervals
findings.evidence: 85 selected passages predate StationDates minimum; north/south end year 2013 differs from Dec 2014 bounds and publication.
findings.impact: A deployment-bound offset would invent receiver effort.

findings.finding: Reliability is downstream and partly manually determined
findings.evidence: 23 literal ReliableEntry IDs plus 45 post-move events; seven NoEntry IDs remain in processed CSV; RData checkpoints missing.
findings.impact: Using all 200 rows as confirmed sluice passage would mix entry routes and certainty.

findings.evidence: 17,691 excess timestamp rows; 54 conflicting timestamp keys in EnviroBedien; nonmonotone source order.
findings.impact: Naive row counts overstate duration and joins can multiply observations.

findings.finding: Processed environmental values already include source imputation
findings.evidence: 20,305 sea-temperature and 22,107 Haringvliet-temperature study-window rows filled where chosen original sensor field is missing; source na.approx uses vector row order.
findings.impact: Complete processed temperature is not complete measurement coverage.

findings.finding: Passage timing fields differ for two corrected fish
findings.evidence: 2065b and 7549 have corrected DateTime_CET but earlier FirstDetectionDate/Time_untilDetection.
findings.impact: Endpoint timestamp and time-since-release need explicit choice.

findings.finding: Raw trail overlap and date anomalies
findings.evidence: 214,051 canonical station/tag/time keys shared across raw sources, including 4,857 HVS; older source contains years 1979, 1983, 2016, 2060.
findings.impact: Raw concatenation and filename-based date assumptions inflate or contaminate endpoints.

scientific_distinction: Aggregate observed detection rates do not necessarily require an individual survival denominator, but they require documented observation effort and a clear observation-process estimand. The archive provides neither complete uptime nor an individual dynamic risk set.
minimum_reopening_requirements: Actual receiver active/outage intervals and station/channel configuration at HVS, independent of detected fish.
Fixed temporal bins, species, station-era treatment, entry endpoint and event de-duplication rules before fitting.
Resolve conflicting environmental timestamps and disclose original source interpolation without silently filling missing effort.
Limit interpretation to detected-tag passage intensity unless fish availability and detection probability are separately supported.
